fixing-re-authentication-with-passkeys-k.reason: The test moved to tests/webauthn/.../passwordless/PasskeysUsernamePasswordFormTest.java (new testsuite) but reauthenticationOfUserWithoutPasskey on main still sets passkeysEnabled(false) before asserting the webauth form is absent, so it short-circuits on isPasskeysEnabled(). UsernamePasswordForm.isConditionalPasskeysEnabled on main is unchanged (isPasskeysEnabled() && (user == null || isConfiguredFor(...))). The 2026-10-06 commit bf57c22456 added an assertion for a user whose passkey was removed, but that path renders via WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator.createErrorResponse/fillContextForm, not the per-user guard, and the named test was not changed.
